sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - P226R is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Oh, hey. There's an unusual matter that has come up. I don't often get orders for pistols, but this is a special occasion. We need a SIG P226R, Stainless Elite Wooden grip, Stainless Elite slide, extended magazine and a flashlight. Ergonomics not below 77, recoil sum not above 610. A weapon for true enthusiasts."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a P226R to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +9,800 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.02
- 300 Euros
  - 315 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 345 Euros Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Gunpowder "Hawk"
- Unlocks purchase of Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle (variant SOPMOD I) at Mechanic LL3
- Unlocks purchase of 5.7x28mm R37.F at Mechanic LL3
"All set? Thanks for your help. Boy, I wish I had one of those in my collection..."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
P226R specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 610 or less recoil
- 77 or more ergonomics
- P226 Stainless Elite pistol slide
- P226 Stainless Elite Wooden pistol grip
- P226 9x19 20-round extended magazine
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard P226R from Peacekeeper LL1.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
